summary: The diff implements %TypedArray%.prototype.some in its own file, keeping the spec step comments in place. Steps 1-7 follow the spec in order: ValidateTypedArray is propagated with `?`, TypedArrayLength is taken once, the IsCallable check throws a TypeError before any element access, and the loop runs TypedArrayGetElement then Call(callback, thisArg, kValue, k, obj) with `?`, then ToBoolean, returning true early and false at the end. There are no special-cased inputs, no made-up values and no swallowed errors. The one lint flag (unreachable! after ValidateTypedArray) is truly unreachable, because RequireInternalSlot throws for non-objects. The BigInt failures are honest not-implemented errors from elsewhere in the engine.
